C: › also gemstone a jewel (= precious stone), especially when cut into a particular regular shape
（尤指切割成規則形狀的）寶石
› someone or something that is very good, pleasing, or useful
難能可貴的人（或物）；被人喜愛的人（或物）；非常有用的人（或物）

example: He's a real gem - you'd be a fool to break up with him.
他可真是個寶貝——你得是個傻瓜才會想要跟他分手。
The coffee house is a hidden gem (= something that not a lot of people know about).
這個咖啡館真是塊隱藏的瑰寶。

NONE: › in Japanese business theory, the place where things happen in manufacturing. Used to say that people making products are in a good place to improve the process by which they are made.
（日本商業理論中的生產）現場
› either of the two muscles of the hip that work together to rotate the thigh
› the third sign of the zodiac, relating to the period 23 May to 21 June , represented by twins (= two people born together), or a person born during this period
雙子座，雙子宮（黃道第三宮）；出生於雙子宮時段（即在5月23日至6月21日之間）的人
